column1:
Incorporating the Beige Book, conditions remain modest to moderate across Districts with ongoing labor-market tightness. Wages are increasing at a modest pace but across a broader range and are expected to rise further, and non-auto retail and transportation activity show continued growth; loan volumes are steady in many areas. Housing is mixed, and energy prices are mixed as well. Layering in SLOOS, credit remains supportive for larger C&I borrowers but continues to tighten in CRE and certain consumer segments, pointing to some downside sensitivity if financial conditions tighten. Net: still cautiously hawkish—gradual hikes remain warranted—with the Beige Book’s broad-based labor tightness and widening wage pressures nudging the stance slightly more hawkish than the SLOOS-only read, though pockets of consumer/CRE softness counsel some guardrails.
